name: Merrows
tagline: An AI-powered rep for voice, chat, SMS and email
description: Merrows is an omnichannel AI-powered customer-service rep for automotive shops, ecommerce and retail brands, and restaurants. It answers phone calls, website chat, SMS and email from one Playbook written in plain language. Setup starts with five questions that draft a working conversation you can talk to before connecting anything. Merrows places orders and bookings in systems you already run, such as Square, Toast, Shopify, Recharge, Redo, Shopmonkey, Tekmetric and Mindbody, and opens handoffs in helpdesks including Gladly, Gorgias, Kustomer, Zammad, Zendesk and Zoho Desk. The chat widget embeds on WordPress, Wix, Squarespace and Webflow. It says it is an AI when asked, hands off the moment a customer wants a person, and keeps conversation data on Merrows' own servers. Self-serve plans start free; every paid plan includes a 14-day free trial, with no card required for chat and email.
